INSTITUTE       FACULTY OF PHARMACY
PROGRAM       BACHELOR OF PHARMACY
SEMESTER         3
COURSE TITLE    PHARMACEUTICAL ORGANIC CHEMISTRY-II
COURSE CODE     13PH0301
COURSE CREDITS  6

Objective:
 1  Write the structure, name and the type of isomerism of the organic compound
 2  Write the reaction, name the reaction and orientation of reactions
 3  Account for reactivity/stability of compounds,
 4  Prepare organic compounds
 5  The syllabus emphasizes on mechanisms and orientation of reactions. Chemistry of fats and
      oils are also included in the syllabus.


Course Outcomes: After completion of this course, student will be able to:
 1  Understand mechanisms and orientation of chemical reactions.
 2  Acquire basic knowledge regarding general methods of preparation of organic compounds.
 3  Understand the reactions and reactivity of some organic compounds and Apply knowledge
     of heterocyclic compounds, electrophilic and nucleophilic reactions.
 4  Understand the chemistry of fats and oils.


Pre-requisite of course:The syllabus emphasizes on mechanisms and orientation of reactions.
Chemistry of fats and oils are also included in the syllabus.

Instructional Method:
